evidence.target_passage: Short title This Act may be cited as the Lori Jackson-Nicolette Elias Domestic Violence Survivor Protection Act . Findings Congress finds the following: Congress has the responsibility to keep the populace of the United States safe, and domestic gun violence is a significant threat to the well-being of the United States. Each year in the United States, more than 900 women are shot and killed by an intimate partner. More women are killed in the United States by domestic partners than by any other type of assailant, and most of these homicides are committed with firearms. Nearly 6,000,000 women alive in the United States today report having a gun used on them by a domestic partner. Seven
